Do not exceed the 5 declared variants. Do not commit.
results.evidence:
Summary: Validated negative for cci_strategy. Report at research/agent_cci/REPORT.md, numbers reproduced by v1/v2/v3 scripts, ruff clean, nothing committed. TEST: 4.56% CAGR, Sharpe -0.18, MaxDD -13.23%, 3.77x/yr turnover, 0.91%/yr cost, 18.7 names. Buy-and-hold 8.16%/0.19; composite 6.55%/0.07; 100-seed random null 5.41%/-0.04 puts CCI at the 24th/12th percentile, paired t=-0.27. Verdict NO. Not a cost story (gross 4.95%). Three harness bugs documented.

Known limitations: The TEST window had already been read and written to PRIMARY_TEST_RESULT.txt by the interrupted run, so this session re-verified an already-consumed TEST set rather than producing a first-touch result. No new parameter was chosen after seeing TEST, but single-touch cannot be restored.; V4_fast (CCI period 10) has the only positive TEST Sharpe (0.21) but a negative TRAIN Sharpe (-0.09). Reported as a curiosity and explicitly NOT promoted: against the 100-seed random-22 null it is a 2.08-sigma single draw, and best-of-5 raises that to p ~ 9%. A fresh out-of-sample window would be required.; The 'equal-weight' comparator exposed by BUG-3 has no correct in-engine replacement beyond the random-22 null, because any constant score panel re-triggers the alphabetical tie-break in build_rebalance_weights. Fixing it would need a change to src/nsealgo, which the brief forbids.; The causal explanation (CCI gate is anti-momentum) is an ablation and a literature-consistent inference, not a formal factor decomposition; the bucket-level reversion edge flips sign between TRAIN (-0.24 pp) and TEST (+0.61 pp).; Costs are modelled at the engine's all_in_round_trip_bps(100000) = 21.92 bps on Rs 1,00,000 reference notionals. A live 22-name book on Rs 21,00,000 has ~10x larger per-position notionals, making the flat DP charge proportionally lighter, so true drag is slightly below what is reported - conservative.; Survivorship bias is present in the panel (today's NIFTY-50 backfilled) and uncorrected. It affects the strategy and buy-and-hold equally so the comparison holds, but absolute CAGRs are optimistic for both.
